Faiz Danial is a 12-year-old boy who struggles at school and to be honest, with life in general. He is an introvert, socially awkward, a day dreamer who has interests other kids just don't understand. He is obsessed with wrestling and when one of his drawings of a wrestler manifests into an imaginary friend; Bonemasher, his life is turned upside down. Bonemasher encourages Iz to be brave, adventurous and follow his dream but his advice is not always the best and ends up getting Iz into some tricky situations.

Insightful adventurer Simon Reeve travels through Denmark, Sweden, Norway, Finland and Iceland and reveals powerful new truths about what has become one of Europe’s most important frontiers.

p.t: Godzilla x Kong: The New Empire
p.d: Two ancient titans, Godzilla and Kong, clash in an epic battle as humans unravel their intertwined origins and connection to Skull Island's mysteries.

Sure or not Are you certain the people asking you for money are really who they say they are? Investigation officers work with the Royal Malaysia Police to follow the trail of scammers targeting multiple victims, swiftly crippling a transnational syndicate.
The daily evening-news programme featuring highlights and coverage of both local and international news with a local perspective.

DEEP IN THE HEART is a visually stunning celebration of Texas wildlife. Told through the eyes of animals ranging from the mysterious blind catfish to the elusive ocelot, the film showcases Texas’ most spectacular landscapes and natural events. Featuring state-of-the-art cinematography, this family-friendly film flows from the high peaks in West Texas, through aquifers, rivers, and bays, and deep into the Gulf of Mexico.
A 1930s-set story centered on the University of Washington's rowing team, from their Depression-era beginnings.

Constantly on the lookout for weapons, illegal travellers, and contraband, Border Security: America's Front Line follows the work of US Customs and Border Protection agents and officers as they screen travellers, inspect cargo, and secure the longest border in the world.

Bai Wei is indeed Lu Xuelin's daughter, and she is determined to find her father's remains to bring back to Shanghai for burial alongside her mother. Meanwhile, in a dark room, Lu Xuelin is chained and has been imprisoned there for four years, unknown to anyone... Shixiang hints that Tianqing is not up to the task and forcefully volunteers to rebuild the house.

Shixiang meets Tianqing in the office for a discussion, during which he attempts to violate Tianqing. At a critical moment, Haisheng appears and saves Tianqing. Longjiao and her accomplices invade the construction site with the intention of killing Tianqing to avenge Haisheng. Nanlan intervenes to rescue Haisheng, and he arrives just in time to stop Longjiao.

Hustle or Bustle is a light-hearted travel infotainment programme where two hosts explore destinations through dual perspectives—one working behind the scenes, the other enjoying the fun. Each episode begins with a challenge to decide their roles, launching a journey full of surprises, laughter, and unseen efforts behind tourism. 《你来工作我来玩》是一档轻松有趣的旅游资讯节目，两位主持人以“一人深入幕后工作，一人纵情玩乐”的双线视角，带领观众了解各地旅游业繁荣背后的汗水与欢笑。每集节目的开场，两位主持人将通过一个小挑战，来决定谁去工作，谁去玩。命运之轮会如何转动？充满惊喜和未知的旅程，即将开启！

p.t: Emerald Hill - The Little Nyonya Story
p.d: This 2025 edition of a Peranakan tale, spun off from the iconic The Little Nyonya, unfolds at Emerald Hill. An Ya, abducted from wealth, endures life in a brothel. Xin Niang, once a child beggar, blossoms into a refined lady. An Na, cast away as a jinx, returns to upend their lives. As secrets unravel, love and kinship are tested---will they rise above fate? 2025 年全新篇章，衍生自经典剧集《小娘惹》的传奇，重塑翡翠山娘惹大家族的兴衰荣辱。大户人家小姐安雅幼年被拐沦落妓院，际遇坎坷；流落街边的小乞丐心娘被大家族收养后蜕变为端庄淑女；从小被视为灾星的千金小姐安娜归来后心怀不轨。三人的命运在亲情，爱情中交织，纠缠不断。她们如何冲破枷锁，改变自己的人生？

Pilgrimage becomes the reason to leave home and set out on a journey. Three companions walk side by side on the long-awaited pilgrimage route of their dreams, covering more than 800km and enduring the triple trials of physical strength, endurance, and spirit. They travel along the Camino de Santiago in Spain and Japan’s Kumano Kodo (a UNESCO World Heritage Site), showcasing the charm and cultural depth of these two great pilgrimage routes. 朝圣，成为离开家乡、出发旅行的理由。三人并肩踏上憧憬已久的朝圣之路，经历了超过800公里，体力、耐力、心灵的三重考验，走访位于西班牙的朝圣之路（圣雅各之路）和日本的熊野古道（世界遗产），展现东西方两条朝圣路线的魅力与文化内涵！

Explorer Chen Ning travels to Yen Bai Province in northwest Vietnam to visit the Black Thai, a branch of the Thai ethnic group. Living in the mountains, their lifestyle and cuisine are closely tied to the environment. During her stay, Chen explores their rich traditions—including the insect cuisine! Can she handle this unique culinary challenge?

Zhang Qingjun, the heir of a business magnate, finds it difficult to express his feelings. His life turns upside down after LI Yingyi, a single mother, starts working at his family's company.

Yingyi has been covering up for her brother-in-law DaoZhi’s massive financial debts over the years while working overnight shifts at the convenience store for the past 3 years. At the same time, her fussy and difficult mother-in-law is thinking of helping her to reject any opportunities of any remarriage prospects.

The show centers on the core objective of internationalizing Chinese pop culture. Through musical competition and fusion, it seeks to bring Chinese-language music to the global stage, focusing on exchange" among Chinese-speaking musicians worldwide. The program emphasizes cultural identity and emotional resonance, embodying the cultural narrative of a community with a shared future for humankind.

Family patriarch Phanu wants his mall to be on top. Eldest son Nathee and his wife Wirin believe the younger generation should lead the business. When Nathee and his eldest son die in a tragic helicopter crash, Wirin is heartbroken. Soon, however, she's shocked to be accused of their murder. Her second son, a monk named Talayluang, is forced to leave the monkhood to help her, and a huge family political battle ensues. 剧情主要讲述了暹罗拉皮集团（Siam Rapi Group）里的家族成员为了能够成为第一继承人而互相争斗的故事。

Hui Buh is a blundering but lovable ghost desperately trying to hold onto his official, cherished "Haunting License". When a king takes over his castle to woo a countess, ghost and royalty end up in one harebrained scheme after another.

His wife leaves—and suddenly a ruthless hitman can’t stand the sight of blood. Max trades bullets for house tours, chasing a fresh start… until his past crashes back in. An offbeat comedy where danger and comedy collide.

By Your Side follows families caring for loved ones with rare diseases, special needs, disabilities and the challenges of ageing. Parents of children with West syndrome and Harlequin ichthyosis navigate seizures, intensive treatments and daily care while celebrating every small achievement. Mothers of adult sons with ADHD, autism and intellectual disabilities devote years to helping them gain confidence, skills and independence. The series also follows families facing ALS and dementia, where spouses and children provide constant care as their loved ones gradually lose their independence. Across generations, these caregivers sacrifice careers, time and personal freedom, yet find strength in love and companionship. Their stories celebrate resilience, acceptance and the preciousness of simply being by someone's side.

In this returning season of FINDING, six heartfelt reunions honour people who left a lasting mark. Nearly 40 years after Basic Military Training, Minister Ong Ye Kung searches for his BMT buddy Eric, while actor-host Noah Yap reunites with Ma’am Haiyan, the mentor who believed in him and supported his family through difficult times. Actor Elvin Ng and his mother travel to Indonesia to surprise Jumi, the domestic helper who became their pillar of strength, while 23-year-old Leticia journeys to Central Java to thank Auntie Mas, who helped raise her for 12 years. Dino Isaac reconnects with the Primary 3 teacher whose kindness gave him hope after a traumatic childhood, while radio DJ Gerald Koh and conservation educator John Chua surprise the teachers who inspired and guided them. Together, these emotional journeys celebrate friendship, gratitude and the lasting impact of those who quietly shape lives.

Pearl Harbor: Minute by Minute is a gripping, real-time account of one of the most devastating and pivotal events in American history—the surprise attack on Pearl Harbor on December 7, 1941. This documentary meticulously reconstructs the events as they unfolded, minute by minute, immersing viewers in the shock, chaos, and heroism that defined the day. Through rare archival footage, eyewitness accounts, and expert commentary, the film captures the tension and drama of the attack, from the early morning hours when the first Japanese planes appeared on the horizon, to the moment bombs and torpedoes rained down on the unsuspecting U.S. naval fleet. The film also explores the aftermath of the attack, delving into the brutal Pacific War and the eventual decision to drop the world’s first atomic bomb on Japan.

In Air Tangan, family bonds are rekindled as generations come together to rediscover cherished family recipes. Watch a Gen Z influencer embark on a culinary adventure with their elder relative, who teaches them the art of traditional Malay cooking while the younger generation introduces modern and fusion dishes. As they cook together, they share personal stories, reminisce childhood memories, and delve into the cultural significance of each dish. Dalam siri Air Tangan, dua generasi berbeza bersatu dan mengukuhkan ikatan keluarga serta memasak resipi keluarga turun temurun. Saksikan pempengaruh Gen Z belajar memasak daripada warga emas dalam keluarga mereka. Pempengaruh itu akan memperkenalkan hidangan moden dan fusion kepada nenek atau Ibu saudara mereka. Sambil memasak bersama, mereka berkongsi kisah peribadi, mengimbas kenangan silam dan menyelami resipi dan asal usul setiap hidangan.
Traveling to different locations to find hidden, delicious and popular foods. Host: Nizam Jentik Jentik in Kajang, KL

Nasar has been retrenched and went for a hotel interview for a porter or 'bellboy' position. Farida, the hotel manager, has offered Nasar a hotel receptionist. The offer made by Farida has caused a conflict between her and Almya, the humanitarian resource officer at the hotel. Nasar needs to learn how to solve problems that arise professionally and efficiently. However, can he do it without affecting his position at his workplace? Will he get the help or be left to solve all the work issues...

A viral video threatens to tear the boys apart just as they prepare for their comeback. When Rayyan wrongly accuses Mia of spreading baseless rumours and threatens her, Isa steps in to protect her.

Azizah is the founder for Bayu Textiles, the leading fabrics company in the industry. She is known for her success and unyielding control. When her eldest son, Amir, marries Emilia, a successful young entrepreneur, Azizah's world begins to crumble. She considers Emilia a rival in both business and family life. Tensions mount as the two women engage in a high stakes battle for power, love, and legacy.

A drama series about the students of SMK Ayer Dalam, who lives are turned upside down when they learn that their school is at risk of being demolished. Putting aside their differences, Alya, Asma, Boi and their friends join forces with thier discipline teacher, Cikgu Azza, to save their beloved school. Along the way, they discover the true meaning of friendship, teamwork and standing up for what matters most.

Kek & Pastri features Dr Ezani and Nabila Huda creating innovative desserts and pastries inspired by local ingredients, especially from Sarawak. Each episode is enlivened by celebrity guests, lighthearted situations and humour, while sharing simple techniques, creative recipe improvisations and delicious modern treats suitable for all audiences.
Sherry Al Hadad is on a mission to entertain her celebrity friends, but she has zero cooking skills! She turns to foster mum, Datin Marlia Musa for help.
Mia discovers that the mysterious songwriter, Isaac, is actually her neighbour, Is Hamdan. Meanwhile, the stalker’s obsession escalates, and Jay makes an alarming discovery in Mal’s room.

p.t: Ollie! The Boy Who Became What He Ate
p.d: Ollie is a 6-year-old with a massive imagination, often lost in his own world - flipping, sliding, climbing and rocket-blasting through the house, practicing at being the master of all things. But even masters need to stop and refuel. When meals or snack time interrupt Ollie’s play, he finds himself confronted with the real challenge of childhood; trying new food. To escape his predicament, Ollie uses his magic spoon to transport himself, along with his sister Poppy, and her stuffy Nummy, to a food planet filled with adventure and the very food Ollie stuck his spoon into.

The Fixies follows the comical misadventures of Tom Thomas and his secret friendship with Simka and Nolik, the children of the Fixie family that lives in his apartment. There’s just no end to the troubles Tom Thomas and his Fixie friends get themselves into with all the gadgets and appliances around them!

Gummy lives in an apartment with his friend Harry the Chameleon, while his other friend Kala the Cat hangs out in a ninja dojo on the roof. Together they go on wild and wacky adventures in their building and hometown. Enjoy the fun and crazy adventures...

Packed with adventure, fun and excitement, HORACI THE INUIT will transport you to the Lands of the North where, together with his best friend Sedna, he will have to solve all kinds of mysteries! Horaci the Inuit takes place in a remote village and talks about universal values such as caring for nature, being intuitive and open-minded and, above all, having a loving respect for family and friends!
Great Projects From Ordinary Cardboard!

The world of Ebb and Flo is seen through Ebb’s eyes and Ebb reveals all the emotions grown-ups try to hide. Flo doesn’t think of Ebb as a dog, and Ebb doesn’t think of Flo as a small human, they just are the best of friends. Until Bird arrives to lovingly disrupt Ebb’s world. Ebb and Flo’s home is an old boat moored by the beach. Things Couldn’t Be Better!
Robo works tirelessly with his loyal friends to protect Car City from Zitron's constant schemes to steal the city's energy source.
We are the VIP Pets! The coolest pets with a passion for hair! We are best friends and together we will discover lots of beautiful hairstyles and go on exciting adventures!
Sweet tooth Om Nom is wandering Around the world, eats a lot of candies and tries to find his Dream job. Watch his adventures and solve different puzzles on the way!

With Chefclub Kids, the little ones get their hands dirty all while having fun in the kitchen. Whether they're learning to prepare dinner, bake goodies, or explore new flavors, Chefclub Kids is a way for children to gain confidence through cooking!

Leo the Wildlife Ranger introduces the secrets and wonders of nature and wildlife around us and kickstarts a curiosity and passion for nature in kids. With engaging missions and adventures, kids have fun while learning positive lessons!
Tom loves caring for his friends; they can always count on Tom to tow them back to his car wash, where they're guaranteed to leave sparking!
